 With Diwali around the corner and Indian stock market preparing to enter Samvat 2083, brokerages have recommended several stocks, identifying opportunities across sectors, including banking, IT, defence, pharmaceuticals, FMCG, telecommunications, steel, defence and engineering.
 Brokerages, including JM Financial, Bonanza Portfolio, Kotak Neo and Bajaj Broking Research have highlighted stocks that could benefit from improving corporate earnings, capacity expansion, infrastructure spending, rising consumption and stronger operational performance.
 The stock recommendations for Muhurat Trading span both fundamental and technical investment strategies, with some stocks offering potential upside of up to 38 percent.
 Diwali Stock Picks 2026 By Brokerages
 Diwali stock picks 2026 by JM Financial 
 Domestic brokerage JM Financial's Diwali recommendations cover 10 stocks across sectors, including banking, defence, power transmission, telecom equipment, metals recycling, pharmaceuticals, new-age businesses, telecommunications, capital goods and steel.

 Diwali stock picks 2026 by Bonanza Portfolio
 With Diwali around the corner, Bonanza Portfolio has also released its Diwali Stock Picks for Samvat 2083, featuring seven stocks across sectors such as IT, banking, pharma, FMCG, steel and engineering. The research note identified potential upside of 18 percent to 38 percent across its picks, including Tata Elxsi, IDFC First Bank, Gland Pharma, Marico, Sambhv Steel Tubes, HBL Engineering and Privi Speciality Chemicals.
 Tata Elxsi: Current Market Price - 3,790 | Target Price - 5,226 | Upside - 38%
 IDFC First Bank : CMP – Rs 72 | Target Price – Rs 92.8 | Upside - 29%
 Gland Pharma: CMP- Rs 3,096 | Target Price – Rs 3,690 | Upside - 19%
 Marico: CMP –Rs 800 | Target Price – Rs 940 | Upside - 18%

 HBL Engineering: CMP – Rs 796 | Target Price – Rs 968 | Upside - 22%

 Kotak Neo’s technical stock picks for Muhurat Trading for Samvat 2083
 Kotak Neo's technical recommendations focus on stocks that have corrected from recent highs but are showing signs of recovery or trading near crucial support levels. The brokerage’s picks include Bajaj Finance, ICICI Bank, JSW Steel, Bharat Electronics and Reliance Industries.
 Bajaj Finance: BUY | Target Price Rs 1,200 | Stop loss Rs 770
 ICICI Bank: BUY | Target Price Rs 1,800 | Stop loss Rs 1,200
 JSW Steel: BUY | Target Price 1,475 | Stop loss Rs 1,150
 Bharat Electronics (BEL): BUY | Target Price 410 | Stop loss Rs 340
 Bajaj Broking Research's nine Diwali stock picks
 With the onset of the festive season, Bajaj Broking Research has identified its Diwali Stock Picks 2026, identifying nine stocks across key sectors that offers potential investment opportunities over a one-year investment horizon, extending until the next Diwali. The stock recommendations are based on a combination of fundamental and technical analysis.
 The research highlights companies demonstrating strong business fundamentals, earnings growth visibility, improving operational performance, robust order books and favourable technical indicators.
 The nine stocks identified by Bajaj Broking Research, along with their recommended entry ranges and target prices, are as follows:
 Fundamental Picks: 
 Mahindra & Mahindra Ltd: Target Price Rs 3,251, upside 13%
 Varun Beverages : Target Price Rs 459, upside 15%
 CG Power & Industrial Solutions: Target Price Rs 938, upside 16%
 GE Vernova T&D India: Target Price Rs 4,545, upside 10%
 Sudarshan Chemical Industries: Target Price 1,144, upside 12%
 Rolex Rings: Target Price Rs 185, upside 12%
 Technical Picks: 
 ICICI Bank: Target Price Rs 1,570, upside 12%
 Adani Power: Target Price Rs 223, upside 16%
 Lloyds Engineering Works: Target Price Rs 99, upside 19%
